verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs assert stablecoin payments 'settle as fiat in your Stripe balance' and payouts appear 'immediately' as a USDC balance (docs-1, docs-9, docs-18), but there is no published fee schedule per rail, no documented settlement-timing SLA, and no crypto-specific accounting statement/report format cited. Community evidence directly contradicts the 'instant settlement' framing, noting that converting USDC back to fiat 'comes with restrictions, delays and fees' (comm-9), and another commenter expresses confusion about how payout settlement actually works (comm-7). missing for 10: published per-rail fee tables, documented settlement-time SLAs, accounting-consumable statements/reports for crypto/stablecoin flows.
